user_decisions.decision: Grant bounded live authorization and credentials early: model; Bright Data keyword, including a bounded discovery corpus for the early marketer check (up to 10 keywords, a few hundred posts); X recent for one topic over a bounded number of windows; the email mailbox's semantics. Per-capability call counts and one spending ceiling.
user_decisions.default: Request at plan start with the smallest useful caps. If not granted, the probes and the early marketer check stay blocked, the build continues on fixtures and premise-dependent specs stay provisional.

user_decisions.decision: Ask at plan start. For live X: (a) may the recorded receipt time bound capture and metric measurement time from above; (b) may an unsaturated single page count as a complete sample of the provider's recent-search results for the literal query; (c) may a saturated window support only lower-bound crossing claims? This amends ADR 0019, ADR 0023 and docs/monitoring.md through new method versions.
user_decisions.default: Accept all three as a narrowly scoped amendment, with market coverage still unknown and installed v1 unchanged. If rejected, live windows stay not assessable, there are no live alerts and no live engagement, and monitoring readiness records blocked_by_decision. Blocks no spec.

user_decisions.decision: Pilot X monitoring depth, revisited after the probe's X row: (a) counts endpoint as the volume series; (b) bounded multi-page collection; (c) shorter cadence within configured cost; (d) accept a saturated lower-bound display. (a) and (b) need an ADR 0023 successor and more recurring paid authority.
user_decisions.default: (c)+(d). The probe's X row records the saturation rate and a recommendation, and the coordinator re-asks. Choosing (a) or (b) adds one M spec before monitoring readiness.

user_decisions.decision: Which supplementary detail route, and is tiktok-web source use permitted?
user_decisions.default: Bright Data profile/post detail fields; tiktok-web stays unavailable.

user_decisions.decision: Permit scoped headless-browser tests against the loopback app, either (i) in CI only with no agent browsing, or (ii) also by agents?
user_decisions.default: Keep declining. Stated cost: graph and chart interaction stay human-verified only, at the browser checkpoint and release record, with Node state tests in between.

user_decisions.decision: W01 initial direction: agent-drafted scope for human approval, and validated fluent synthesis.
user_decisions.default: Proceed with the disabled candidate under the recommended 'yes' branches as non-binding working assumptions; enabling stays decision-blocked.

user_decisions.decision: Pilot email goes to one configured recipient through SMTP submission from an operator-supplied mailbox account; multi-recipient preferences come later.
user_decisions.default: Yes, with SMTP submission. If the operator has only an HTTP email API account, inbox-email uses it behind the same delivery-identity model.
